content: You've had a very dangerous life, haven't you, Joe?
Last year. It was during the British Grand Prix. I knocked into a wall. The car was completely destroyed and my left leg was broken. Luckily nobody was killed.
Is that the only time you've been..., er... close to death?
No, I had a very frightening experience quite recently. I was frightened to death! I thought I was going to be killed at any moment.
It was on my way to this studio. I had to drive through London during the lunch hour.
